svg.title: The earlier certified route: exactly 19 defect-graph types
svg.desc: All graphs on six vertices with maximum degree at most two, up to relabeling. Each component is a path P or cycle C, with its vertex count in the subscript. Grouped by edge count, there are 1,1,2,4,5,4,2 types, totaling 19. A drawn edge marks an aggregate block of rank different from one, including a zero block.
svg.text: The earlier certified route: exactly 19 defect-graph types
Draw an edge when its 3 × 3 aggregate block has rank ≠ 1. Every vertex has degree ≤ 2.
Pₖ = path on k vertices (P₁ is isolated). Cₖ = cycle on k vertices. “+” means disjoint components.
